retrieved.title: Replacement Parts Process
retrieved.heading: How to ask for a replacement part
retrieved.text:
If a part is missing or defective, you can ask Fernhollow to replace it. Customers contact Customer care. Dealers and distributors contact the Quality team. Send these items:
1. The part number from the parts list in the manual.
2. The order number or the serial number of the machine.
3. The model, such as FH-520 stump grinder.
4. Photos of the missing area or the defective part.
5. A short description of the problem.

retrieved.title: Fernhollow Limited Warranty Summary
retrieved.heading: How claims are decided
retrieved.text: A Fernhollow staff member reviews every claim and decides the remedy. The remedy can be a repair, a replacement part, a replacement machine, or no remedy if the cause is not covered. Nothing is approved until a Fernhollow staff member confirms it in writing. Do not assume a claim is approved from a phone call or a chat. The staff member may ask for more photos or for the machine to be sent for inspection.

retrieved.title: Returns and Damaged-on-Arrival Policy for Customers
retrieved.heading: How cases are decided
retrieved.text: Customer care reviews each case. A Fernhollow staff member decides on a repair, a part, an exchange, or a refund. No outcome is promised before the review ends. Staff will confirm the decision in writing. Do not ship the machine back until Customer care gives you return instructions.

next_steps: Ask for photos and the order or serial number if they are missing.
